description: "Lothair" by Earl of Beaconsfield Benjamin Disraeli is a novel published in 1870. A wealthy young Scottish nobleman finds himself torn between three compelling women, each representing different religious and political allegiances: the Church of England, Roman Catholicism, and revolutionary idealism.
